verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal app for iOS. Terminal apps can plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions any AI assistant or task delegation. The documented features cover shell commands, programming languages, Vim, package installation, Shortcuts integration and appearance configuration, none of which is an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
